answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestation rings and dilute challenge shares. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 3-epoch work bond of 0.12 POA unlocked only after peers score ≥2; a nebula of ≥7 independent graders must countersign, and a clone's bond burns if its graph shows a ripple of reciprocal attests >40% within 2 hops. Cost: 0.12 POA locked plus ~90s stamp mining per seat. Verification: explorer lists bond_txid, grader-set size, and reciprocity ratio. Failure: if graders collude as a comet clique, reciprocity flags the ring and burns bonds without paying the challenge pool.
